learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the standard markup language used to create web pages and build your very first website from scratch!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: तत्व (ओपनिंग टैग से क्लोजिंग टैग तक)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It is not a programming language; it's a markup language used to structure the content on a web page using tags.
Every HTML page has a skeleton: `<html>` wraps everything, `<head>` contains the `<title>` (shown on the browser tab), and `<body>` contains all the visible content (text, images).

Container tags have an opening and a closing tag (like ` Bold `). Empty tags only have an opening tag and do not wrap content (like `
` for a line break or `
` for a horizontal line).

Headings range from `

` (smallest). Paragraphs use `

`. You can make text bold ``, italic ``, or underlined ``.

fun_activity.title: 🕵️‍♂️ View Page Source
fun_activity.instructions: Open your favorite website on a computer, right-click anywhere on the page, and select 'View Page Source'. You will see thousands of lines of code. Look closely, and you'll spot `<html>`, `<head>`, and `<body>` tags!

exam_tips: 📌 HTML files must be saved with a `.htm` or `.html` extension.
📌 `<sub>` is for subscript (like the '2' in H₂O) and `<sup>` is for superscript (like the '2' in x²).
📌 An Attribute always goes inside the OPENING tag (e.g., `<font color="red">`).
quick_recap: ⭐ HTML is not case-sensitive, meaning `<html>` and `<HTML>` are treated the same.

⭐ White spaces and multiple line breaks in your text editor are ignored by the browser unless you use the `
` tag.
⭐ The `<title>` tag must always be placed inside the `<head>` section.
